skill.summary: Extract text from PDF files for LLM processing

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of pdf-extract-hardened:

- Extracts text from PDF files for LLM processing using pdftotext.
- Supports extracting all text or specific page ranges from PDFs.
- Includes default and configurable security guardrails to protect sensitive data during extraction and sharing.
- Requires the poppler-utils package for installation.
